channel.title: daryo
channel.description: Regional headlines in English, updated four times a day.

item.title: Uzbekistan President Discusses Business Growth Conditions with Entrepreneurs
item.description: Uzbekistan's President Shavkat Mirziyoyev held an open dialogue with entrepreneurs in Khiva, marking a new phase for the private sector. Discussions focused on growth conditions for established businesses, including access to finance, technology, markets, and a stable regulatory environment. State policy is shifting towards supporting businesses at all development stages.

item.title: Uzbekistan Engages in High-Level Diplomacy with India, Pakistan, and Azerbaijan-Armenia Talks
item.description: Uzbekistan's foreign policy prioritizes trust and cooperation. Recent high-level contacts include Uzbek President Mirziyoyev's visit to India focusing on trade and energy, and meetings with Pakistan's PM on economic and transport ties. Additionally, Azerbaijan's Aliyev met Armenia's Pashinyan at the SCO summit to discuss economic and energy cooperation.

item.title: SCO countries to conduct joint emergency response exercises
item.description: Following the summit in Bishkek, SCO member states have agreed to provide priority humanitarian aid to members affected by emergencies. The initiative, proposed by Kyrgyzstan, also includes Russia's suggestion to create reserve funds for crisis response. Information exchange mechanisms will be improved.

item.title: Infectious Disease Research Center construction begins in Kyrgyzstan
item.description: Construction has commenced on a new scientific center for infectious disease research in Kyrgyzstan, according to the Ministry of Health. The facility aims to enhance the country's scientific potential and healthcare system's readiness to respond to disease threats through laboratory research and specialist training.

item.title: New judge appointed to Moskovsky District Court in Kyrgyzstan
item.description: Artur Shadybekov has been appointed as a judge to the Moskovsky District Court of Chui region, Kyrgyzstan, for a five-year term. He officially assumed his duties after taking the oath of office. The appointment was made in accordance with presidential decrees. Supreme Court Chairman Mederbek Satyev attended the ceremony and congratulated the new judge.

item.title: Uzbekistan aims to attract more family tourists from India, launching flights from Hyderabad to Tashkent
item.description: Uzbekistan plans to increase tourist flow from India, focusing on family travel with children. The Committee for Tourism is negotiating with Indian bloggers and tour operators to promote Uzbekistan as a safe destination. New Hyderabad-Tashkent flights will operate twice weekly starting September 28.

item.title: Kyrgyz poet Akbar Ryskulov explains signing 'letter of 75' advocating early presidential elections
item.description: Kyrgyz national poet and diplomat Akbar Ryskulov stated he signed the 'letter of 75' without realizing its implications, seeing it as a call for economic development and stability. He testified as a witness in the ongoing trial related to the letter, which proposed early presidential elections.

item.title: Indian Citizens Can Now Enter Uzbekistan Visa-Free with Visas from 8 Countries
item.description: Starting September 1, 2026, Indian citizens with valid multiple-entry business or tourist visas from Australia, USA, UK, Canada, South Korea, Schengen states, New Zealand, or Japan can enter Uzbekistan visa-free for up to 30 days.

item.title: Uzbek citizens must travel to Moscow for Thai visa payments after September 15, 2026
item.description: Thailand will cancel its visa-free regime for Uzbek citizens starting September 15, 2026, requiring advance visa applications. While applications can be submitted online, applicants must personally visit the Thai embassy in Moscow to pay the visa fee in cash. Uzbekistan's Foreign Ministry is negotiating with Thailand for more convenient conditions.

item.title: Israel ready for Iranian retaliation during Jewish holidays, says Defense Minister Kats
item.description: Defense Minister Kats stated that Israel is prepared for a potential Iranian attack during the upcoming Jewish holidays in mid-September. He affirmed that Israeli forces are ready to respond to any such aggression, indicating a state of readiness amidst heightened regional tensions.

item.title: Tajikistan and South Korea's LS Corporation Discuss Energy Cooperation
item.description: Tajikistan's Minister of Energy and Water Resources met with representatives from South Korea's LS Corporation in Dushanbe to discuss energy sector cooperation, investment attraction, and joint projects. LS Corporation presented its expertise in electrical engineering, equipment manufacturing, and cable production, expressing interest in further dialogue and mutually beneficial collaboration.

item.title: Tajikistan and EU discuss industrial cooperation, focusing on light industry and textile production
item.description: Tajikistan's Minister of Industry met with the EU Ambassador to discuss industrial cooperation, particularly in light industry, textile production, and cotton processing. Both sides expressed readiness for continued dialogue.

item.title: Denmark Deploys Troops to Greenland Amid Rising Tensions
item.description: Denmark has sent conscripted military personnel to Greenland for the first time in recent history. This deployment aims to strengthen its position in the Arctic amidst diplomatic disagreements with the US and rising geopolitical tensions in the region.

item.title: Tashkent Agency Vows to Prevent Demolition of Historic House
item.description: Tashkent's Cultural Heritage Agency will prevent any illegal attempts to demolish or alter a historic house on Bobur Street. The agency stated the building's status as a cultural heritage site will be preserved, rejecting previous proposals to remove it from the national registry.

item.title: Dushanbe to Host Artificial Intelligence and Digital Technologies Festival
item.description: Dushanbe will host the AI ALLEY festival on September 5, 2026, showcasing artificial intelligence, innovation, and digital technologies. Organized by the Agency for Innovation and Digital Technologies, the event will feature IT companies, startups, universities, and interactive programs for the public.

item.title: Kyrgyzstan's AI-92 gasoline prices increased by nearly 1.5 percent in August
item.description: In August, AI-92 gasoline prices in Kyrgyzstan rose by 1.46 percent, reaching 89.11 soms per liter. AI-95 gasoline saw a 0.53 percent increase, costing 109.27 soms. Diesel fuel prices slightly decreased by 0.17 percent to 101.69 soms. Since the start of the year, gasoline prices have increased significantly.

item.title: Chingiz Kaziev appointed Deputy Chief of Staff of Kyrgyzstan's Parliament
item.description: Chingiz Kaziev has been appointed Deputy Chief of Staff of the Zhogorku Kenesh, Kyrgyzstan's parliament. Venera Kulataeva, the former Deputy Chief of Staff, is now the First Deputy Chief of Staff. These appointments were formalized by Marlen Mamataliev, the Speaker of the Zhogorku Kenesh.

item.title: Tajikistan and Iran discuss cooperation prospects for Sangtudinskaya HPP-2
item.description: On September 2, 2026, Dushanbe hosted a meeting between Tajikistan's Minister of Energy and Water Resources and the CEO of Iran's "Sangob" company. They discussed the current state and future prospects of cooperation in the energy sector, specifically regarding the Sangtudinskaya HPP-2.

item.title: Air Arabia Selected to Transport Kyrgyz Pilgrims to Hajj in 2027
item.description: Air Arabia has been chosen to transport 6,060 Kyrgyz pilgrims to Saudi Arabia for Hajj in 2027. The decision followed a competition by an interdepartmental commission. In previous years, Kyrgyz pilgrims were transported by Saudi Arabian airlines Flyadeal and Jazeera Airways.

item.title: Chinese President Xi Jinping Arrives in Egypt for State Visit
item.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in Cairo for a state visit to Egypt at the invitation of President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi. Xi Jinping was warmly welcomed by President el-Sisi and his wife. The Chinese president highlighted the long-standing friendship and mutually beneficial cooperation between China and Egypt.

item.title: Tashkent traffic volume increased by 30% on the first day of the academic year
item.description: Tashkent experienced a 30% increase in car traffic on the first day of the academic year. Most major intersections are connected to a digital system that monitors road conditions, traffic light operation, vehicle queues, and public transport movement.

item.title: Uzbekistan Integrates into Global Market Through Economic Reforms
item.description: Uzbekistan has transitioned from a closed, resource-based economy to a modern model integrating into the global market. Reforms like currency convertibility and tax liberalization have attracted foreign investment, particularly in green energy, textiles, and pharmaceuticals. Trade now spans over 160 countries, with key partners including China, Russia, Turkey, South Korea, and Central Asian nations.

item.title: Uzbek Startup Speko Launches on Product Hunt for Voice AI Solutions
item.description: Uzbek founder Beknazar Abdikamalov's startup, Speko, has launched on Product Hunt, addressing a key challenge in the global Voice AI market. Speko helps developers find optimal solutions for specific languages by integrating various providers through a single API, overcoming limitations of single-vendor systems.

item.title: Uzbekistan and Kazakhstan enhance cooperation on transboundary water resource protection
item.description: Uzbekistan and Kazakhstan are strengthening collaboration on protecting and rationally using transboundary water resources, crucial for regional ecological stability and water security. A recent expert meeting, initiated by the UN ECE, focused on protecting the Tashkent transboundary aquifer and developing a partnership memorandum.

item.title: Kazakhstan Introduces Electronic Entry Permit for Visa-Free Travelers
item.description: Starting August 25, Kazakhstan has implemented new legislation requiring an electronic entry permit for foreign citizens arriving from visa-free countries. The Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA), known as QazETA, will be processed through a digital platform. This new entry procedure was established by a law signed by President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev.

item.title: Uzbekistan's SCO Summit Initiatives Focus on Security and Economic Connectivity
item.description: Uzbekistan's President Mirziyoyev presented initiatives at the Bishkek SCO summit, emphasizing the organization's importance in Tashkent's foreign policy. The SCO is key for Uzbekistan to strengthen regional security, expand continental economic ties, and pursue an open, multi-vector foreign policy, as highlighted by the Institute for Strategic and Regional Studies.

item.title: New Specialized Boarding School Opens in Navoi for Talented Youth
item.description: A new specialized boarding school named after Al-Khwarizmi, with a capacity of 504 students, has opened in Navoi. The school aims to identify and nurture young talent, enhance scientific potential, and provide conditions for acquiring modern professions. The region reported a significant increase in students scoring maximum university entrance exam points.

item.title: Uzbekistan Reviews Progress on Nuclear Power Plant Construction and Satellite City Project
item.description: President Shavkat Mirziyoyev reviewed the construction progress of an integrated nuclear power plant and a satellite city in Jizzakh region. The project, crucial for energy security, has begun active construction, with significant excavation and concrete work completed. The total cost is $9.5 billion, with a goal to increase local product share to 30%.

item.title: Uzbekistan to Review 2026-2027 Budgets for Nuclear Power Project
item.description: Uzbekistan's Ministry of Economy and Finance will revise the 2026-2027 spending estimates for the "Uzatom" agency and the Directorate for the Construction of the Nuclear Power Plant. President Mirziyoyev instructed timely financing and avoiding delays in the project.

item.title: Xi Jinping Calls for New Middle East Security Architecture, Offers Maritime Security Cooperation
item.description: Xi Jinping urged the creation of a new security architecture for the Middle East and stated China's readiness to cooperate with regional states on maritime route security. This initiative gains importance due to disruptions in shipping through the Hormuz and Bab al-Mandab straits.

item.title: South Korean Police Suspect Four Uzbek Citizens of Supporting Terrorists
item.description: South Korean police have detained one and are investigating three other Uzbek citizens suspected of financing and supporting the Syrian-based organization 'Katiba al-Tawhid wal-Jihad' (KTJ). One suspect allegedly transferred cryptocurrency worth $4,600 to the group and purchased vehicles later sent to Syria.

item.title: UN Adopts Tajikistan's Initiative for International AI Day
item.description: The UN General Assembly has adopted a resolution initiated by Tajikistan, proclaiming August 31st as the International Day of Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence starting in 2027. This initiative builds on previous proposals and aims to foster global attention and cooperation on AI development and governance.

item.title: SCO Summit in Bishkek: Leaders Meet Amidst Questions About Bloc's Future
item.description: Leaders including Putin, Xi, and Modi attended the SCO summit in Bishkek. The article questions why the organization, representing 40% of the global population, has not evolved into a stronger union in its 25 years of existence.

item.title: Uzbekistan Proposes SCO Transformation into Geoeconomic Driver
item.description: At the SCO summit marking its 25th anniversary, Uzbekistan's President Shavkat Mirziyoyev presented a vision for the organization's future, titled 'SCO-2040: Space of Common Development.' This initiative aims to transform the SCO into a powerful geoeconomic driver, facilitating investment, technology, and infrastructure projects.

item.title: UN Security Council to vote on Iran sanctions monitoring in September
item.description: The UN Security Council will vote in September on the monitoring of Iran sanctions, a move that could lead to confrontation with Russia and China. Both countries oppose the sanctions regime against Iran and the mechanisms overseeing its implementation.

item.title: IAEA notes Uzbekistan's nuclear infrastructure development but highlights unfinished issues
item.description: Uzbekistan has made significant progress in developing its nuclear energy infrastructure, but still needs to complete feasibility studies and strengthen its nuclear regulatory body, according to an IAEA mission. Officials reported high assessment of national nuclear infrastructure development to President Mirziyoyev.

item.title: Uzbekistan Implements New Data Management Model in National Statistics
item.description: Uzbekistan's President Shavkat Mirziyoyev reviewed results of the population and agricultural census, revealing preliminary figures of 39.047 million permanent residents. The census identified discrepancies in regional population data and clarified land boundaries, leading to a new data management model for national statistics.

item.title: International Financial Institutions Boost Green Energy in Uzbekistan
item.description: Uzbekistan is prioritizing renewable energy as a key element of its green economic growth strategy, aligning with the 'Uzbekistan-2030' plan. The country aims to increase the share of renewables to 54% of electricity production by 2030, requiring enhanced cooperation with International Financial Institutions (IFIs).

item.title: Ukraine Warns ICAO of 'Unsafe Russian Airspace' Due to Drone Activity
item.description: Ukraine has officially warned the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) about the unsafe conditions in Russian airspace due to drone activity. Ukraine urges caution and calls for a ban on flights over Russia.

item.title: Turkey to Consider Full Membership in Shanghai Cooperation Organisation
item.description: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan stated that Turkey will consider full membership in the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO). He emphasized that this prospect does not entail severing ties with any other bloc or the West. Erdogan made these remarks after attending the SCO summit in Bishkek.
